usage: model_route.py [-h]
                      {resolve,snapshot,health,probe,select,routes,cooldowns,reset,pick} ...

Resolve durable harness model aliases into auditable concrete routes.

positional arguments:
  {resolve,snapshot,health,probe,select,routes,cooldowns,reset,pick}
    routes              print each route pool with live availability
    cooldowns           show cooldowns for the selected accounts on this host
    reset               clear cooldowns: all, one adapter, or adapter/model
    pick                pick models from route pools; JSON requests on stdin

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
